provenance.basis: TCI1925 work image, visible southern oblique principal street corridor from the Risorgimento side toward the river. Width is the inherited 10m southern-avenue estimate, not a measured historic width.

provenance.basis: TCI1925 work image, visible western north-south street corridor joining the three oblique routes; its southern end stops at the printed Risorgimento-side junction and does not continue into Borgo.
